from pathlib import Path
from tempfile import TemporaryDirectory
import subprocess
import sys
with TemporaryDirectory() as td:
    p = Path(td) / 'bad.md'
    p.write_text('# Bad Plan\n\n## Story Shape\n')
    result = subprocess.run([sys.executable, 'scripts/validate_plan_runbook.py', str(p)], capture_output=True, text=True)
    assert result.returncode != 0
    assert 'Missing required sections' in result.stdout or 'Missing required sections' in result.stderr
